title: Solid, but has serious performance issues
body:
It works great if you’re in the ecosystem, and it has enough features for a basic note taking app. 
But I just can’t get over the fact that the note taking experience with the Apple Pencil 2 is probably the worst on the AppStore, including all the 3rd party apps. It starts out great, but the more you write the latency just gets worse and worse. Just after a full page of writing on my M1 iPad Pro the latency gets so bad that you see a letter appear only after you’ve finished writing it on the screen. And that isn’t even the worst part. My device gets super hot during note taking. It gets to the point that it’s uncomfortable to rest your wrist on the screen. 
And to top it all off, the app practically eats through the battery. Approximately 1.5% on every minute. I’ve yet to play a game on my iPad that drains the battery that much. 

It’s just really hard for me to understand that the official note taking app from Apple has such an awful performance. It appears that the problem is only with hand writing, but that’s what I primarily use it for. Please fix this mess.
